title: Campania Diesel Prices Climb for a Fifth Straight Day
dek: Self-service Gasolio in the region has risen nearly 6.7 cents per liter over the past week, edging past the national average even as petrol stays a shade cheaper than the rest of Italy.
body: As of July 25, drivers in Campania paid an average of €1.988 per liter for self-service Benzina and €2.204 for self-service Gasolio. Petrol came in just under the national self-service average of €1.992 — a small but real discount — while diesel nudged slightly above the €2.203 national mark, a reversal from earlier in the week when the region trailed the country on both fuels.

The trend over the last five tracked days has been steadily upward: self-service Benzina rose from €1.951 to €1.988 (+3.6 cents), and self-service Gasolio climbed from €2.138 to €2.204 (+6.7 cents) — one of the sharper weekly diesel increases the dashboard has logged. Meanwhile the region's station network held steady at 2,114 registered pumps, with 1,851 reporting prices today, a two-station uptick in reporting activity from the day before that suggests the local network is keeping pace even as prices move.

Tracking a single region's daily swings against a national baseline — and doing it fresh every morning for all 20 regions in rotation — would be a nightmare to maintain by hand in a spreadsheet. Fuel Dashboard pulls the official MIMIT data, recalculates the numbers, and rebuilds itself automatically each day, entirely orchestrated by Claude Code, so this kind of granular, region-by-region reporting stays accurate without anyone babysitting it.
pull_quote: Campania diesel has climbed 6.7 cents a liter in just five days — one of the steepest weekly run-ups the dashboard has tracked.
caption:
Today's Fuel Dashboard spotlight: Campania, where self-service diesel has jumped 6.7 cents a liter in just five days and now edges past Italy's national average.

Fuel Dashboard tracks daily petrol and diesel prices across all 20 Italian regions, pulling directly from Italy's official MIMIT price feed. Today Campania's self-service Benzina sits at €1.988/L (just under the national €1.992 average) while Gasolio has climbed to €2.204/L, now slightly above the national €2.203 mark — a real shift from where the region started the week.

What makes this possible: the entire dashboard, data ingestion, regional rotation, and daily article generation runs itself. No manual spreadsheet, no copy-pasting numbers into Excel every morning. I built it with Claude Code, and it rebuilds and republishes automatically every day. It's a small but concrete example of what's possible when you let an AI coding tool own an entire pipeline instead of just writing one script.

Check out the live dashboard: https://adeo-blip.github.io/fuel-price-italy/
